features.title: A clip shelf for coding agents
features.intro: VAS is a library of short motion clips, each one technique rebuilt from a well-made video. You browse and fill a cart. Your coding agent connects over MCP, reads each clip's technique and builds the video from them.

items.name: Search
items.text: Type what the video is for, or pick a suggestion like Tech promo. Matching clips fill the page, and one button adds them all to the cart.

items.name: Clip notes
items.text: A clip opens over the page. Details says what happens in it, why it feels premium, and when to use or avoid it. Copy prompt writes your agent a request to use it.

items.name: Cart
items.text: Clips go into a cart without signing in, and the cart suggests others to go with them. Copy for your agent turns it into a prompt listing the clip IDs and asking for one film.

items.name: Agent setup
items.text: One button copies a line for your coding agent, which then adds VAS as an MCP server. After one browser sign-in, the agent has eleven tools to search clips and save them to projects.
